title: Watering can
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body of watering can -->
  <rect x="28" y="38" width="44" height="40" rx="8" fill="#2E9E5D"/>
  <!-- Lighter panel on body -->
  <rect x="34" y="44" width="32" height="28" rx="5" fill="#48C97C"/>
  <!-- Top rim -->
  <rect x="26" y="34" width="48" height="8" rx="4" fill="#1F7A47"/>
  <!-- Handle -->
  <path d="M72 42 Q88 42 88 58 Q88 72 72 72" fill="none" stroke="#1F7A47" stroke-width="7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Spout -->
  <path d="M28 62 L8 36" fill="none" stroke="#2E9E5D" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- Spout head / rose -->
  <circle cx="8" cy="34" r="7" fill="#7DE0A8"/>
  <circle cx="8" cy="30" r="1.6" fill="#C8F7DC"/>
  <circle cx="12" cy="32" r="1.6" fill="#C8F7DC"/>
  <circle cx="5" cy="34" r="1.6" fill="#C8F7DC"/>
  <circle cx="10" cy="36" r="1.6" fill="#C8F7DC"/>
  <circle cx="6" cy="38" r="1.6" fill="#C8F7DC"/>
  <circle cx="12" cy="38" r="1.6" fill="#C8F7DC"/>
  <!-- Water drops spilling from spout -->
  <ellipse cx="4" cy="46" rx="2.2" ry="3.2" fill="#5BC8FA"/>
  <ellipse cx="12" cy="48" rx="2" ry="3" fill="#5BC8FA"/>
  <ellipse cx="8" cy="54" rx="2.4" ry="3.6" fill="#5BC8FA"/>
  <!-- Little highlight on body -->
  <rect x="38" y="50" width="6" height="14" rx="3" fill="#9AF0BE" opacity="0.6"/>
</svg>
